summary: First full end-to-end test run for Nirman Udyog. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass (public content, auth+JWT cookies, brute-force protection wiring, tiles/demo-photos/blog CRUD with Create->GET->Update->Delete verification, category & site-settings PUT, image upload via Emergent object storage + /api/media/{path} serving, sitemap.xml). Frontend: All critical user flows verified end-to-end on public preview URL - Home hero + 6 room cards + featured tiles + trust strip (15+ years, Authorized Kajaria Dealer), sticky WhatsApp bar with wa.me/919475833221 + tel:9475833221, room /tiles/bathroom with type filter chips, tile detail with WA CTA containing tile name+SKU (verified: 'Aqua Marine* (SKU: NU-CER-116)'), Gallery with lightbox + prev/next/close, Blog list with 3 posts, About/Contact (no form, business info present), robots.txt=200, /api/sitemap.xml=200 with bathroom URL, admin login wrong-password shows 'Invalid email or password', correct login redirects to /admin, admin tiles list shows 18 seeded rows, admin demo-photos/settings/blog load, logout + re-visit /admin/tiles redirects to /admin/login, mobile hamburger shows all 6 rooms + Gallery/Blog/About/Contact links.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origins is single FRONTEND_URL - acceptable for prod, but for local dev an additional http://localhost:3000 origin may be useful. Current preview URL works.
Cookies use samesite='none', secure=True, httponly=True - correct for cross-site preview URL usage.
seed_admin: correctly updates existing admin's password hash if it changed - idempotent.
bcrypt hash format is $2b$ (verified via successful login flow).
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection {'_id': 0} and _strip helper - good.

Minor: admin_get_tile is defined but there is no admin_get_demo_photo endpoint (only POST/PUT/DELETE/list). The DemoPhotoForm may need it for edit-load; front-end may filter list to find by id instead. Not currently a blocker.
Minor: /api/media/{path} does not verify path safety, but path is generated server-side and stored key is used by object storage; low risk.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing idempotent seeded data (18 tiles, 24 demo photos, 6 categories, 3 blog posts, 1 site_settings). Test CRUD created & deleted TEST_-prefixed items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 27 tests). Model gotchas: DemoPhotoCreate has 'caption' field (not 'title'); ImageAsset requires 'id' field; site_settings uses 'whatsapp_number' key (not 'whatsapp'). Admin login sets samesite=none secure httponly cookies; requests.Session works for authenticated calls. Featured tiles endpoint takes ?featured=true.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Initial test failures were assertion mismatches on my side (wrong field names) which were fixed. The app is production-ready for the tested feature scope.
